mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month directly reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in lower financing costs for corporations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 255.0, it signals persistent inflation that triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors discount higher future interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where CPIAUCSL > 255.0, or the Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1100.0 and unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% indicates an overheating economy with tight labor markets and strong housing demand, which typically precedes a Fed rate hike and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 108.0 signals an economic slowdown that prompts the Federal Reserve to pause or reverse rate hikes, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates policy accommodation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month indicates a strengthening labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to improved economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200.0, it signals robust consumer demand for housing and a strong economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods where HOUST > 1200.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1100.0 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 500000.0 indicates a weakening consumer sector that typically precedes a slowdown in corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 108.0 signals a severe economic contraction due to supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in reduced corporate output and potential recession.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances during supply shocks, or the Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
